title: Naturality and involutivity of rational signed tensor symmetry
statement: For a finite coefficient field E and a separated finite-type X over the finite-field datum D, the specified rational Koszul swap is natural in both inputs and the swap in the opposite order is its inverse. The equations concern pullbackTensorRationalBraiding and rationalDerivedTensor, not an unspecified monoidal structure.

source.place: Proof paragraphs 1–3; explicit interface extracted from lem-coef-rational-retract-evaluation

proof.text: Conjugate the coherent signed tensor symmetry by the actual integral reduction/tensor comparisons. Naturality follows from naturality of the coherent swap and of these comparisons. The faithful derived-complete reduction detects the equation.

For degrees r,s two signed swaps multiply to (-1)^(2*r*s)=1. The same reduction comparison therefore identifies the integral opposite swap with the inverse. Rationalization carries this identity to the specified rational swap. For rational naturality, expand each arrow as a finite sum of pure tensors: integral naturality gives the equation on generators, and separate bilinearity gives it on all arrows.
